answer: Audits are entered in garden, queued in timber, and jetty publishes the wait time. A farm of 359 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 97 identities per epoch. A farm of 3627 identities would post 3688 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
